description: Minute-by-minute capital flow for a concept or industry, summed over its current active constituents — the same basis as `main_net_in` in `concepts list`. Same field semantics as the per-security `fundflow` verb: `*_cum` are running day totals (never sum across bars), `*_delta` is the per-bar change. Amounts are CNY, positive = net inflow. Each bar carries `covered_members`, how many constituents had data by that minute. Pass `kind=industry` when the id is a Shenwan industry. Use it to see whether a theme is being accumulated or distributed while it moves.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

date.description: Trade date YYYY-MM-DD (default: today, Beijing time)

kind.description: Dimension: concept (hot-theme library, default), base (broad base labels), or industry. All use independent chain-linked equal-weight indices with base 1000. A stored theme membership alone does not establish current trading activity; use concept_tags for current status.

name: concepts_fundflow_minute
